command: echo HOST=$(hostname); echo FRANK=$(command -v frank 2>/dev/null || true); echo BINS; ls -1 $HOME/.local/bin/*frank* 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; echo REPO_HEAD=$(git -C $HOME/frankenstein-repo rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); echo REPO_BRANCH=$(git -C $HOME/frankenstein-repo branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true); echo REPO_STATUS; git -C $HOME/frankenstein-repo status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo STAR_HASHES; sha256sum $HOME/.claude/star/stern.py $HOME/.claude/star/harness_aider.py $HOME/.claude/star/harness_audit.py 2>/dev/null || true; echo BRIDGE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true); echo BUEHNE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service 2>/dev/null || true)
